newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bonds flat, crown softens at lunch.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bonds flat, crown softens at lunch.

text.p: Yields were flat and the crown marginally weaker by Thursday noon with dealers expecting a minor recoil following a period of a strengthening for the crown against the mark.

"I think we will see a stronger mark as people start taking profit", one dealer said. He thought the crown would come back to around 4.30 to the mark. But the recoil is expected to be temporary and of no importance to the trend of a firming crown.
"We have not seen any real recoils lately and I don't think we will see any now either. The positive trend will continue", another dealer said.
